Department of Defense Facility

Only individuals who are specifically eligible for care at a military Medical Treatment Facility (MTF) are eligible to receive treatment at an MTF. MTF care is otherwise not available to members of the civilian population.

Indian Health Service (federal, tribal, and urban) sites will provide access to services in accordance with established eligibility requirements.
